texts.zh: [from.target.GetName]的一个主脑错误地把我们的特工认定为食物，现在正热情洋溢地在狩猎它们。这种特定的[from.target.GetSpeciesName][from.target.GetIndividualName]似乎会本能地会把除自己以外的任何个体当作潜在的营养来源。
texts.en: A primal aspect of the [from.target.GetName] entity has mistaken our operatives for food, and is now fixated upon hunting them. This particular [from.target.GetSpeciesName] [from.target.GetIndividualName] seems to instinctively regard anything other than itself as a source of potential nutrition.
